text:
Morgan: Hey folks — PR up for the dashboards + trace hook metric. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4924 Please take a quick look when you have a sec. Mainly: 1) new dashboard panels, 2) trace hook emits span_count metric, 3) tiny schema migration. Need two approvals before merge, aiming to merge today EOD if green. :eyes:

Nina: I can take a look after stand; ping me again around 10:30am?

Mike: Happy to review, will run locally in ~45m.

Jordan: OOO atm — back at 3pm PT. If it's small I can give a quick approve then. @Morgan can you tag required approvers in the PR?

Sam: left a couple inline comments about legend labels and unit conversions.

Morgan: thanks — added @Nina and @Jordan to reviewers. Sam, saw your comments, addressing now. Quick test command if helpful:
```bash
pytest tests/observability/test_dashboard.py::test_render -k span_count -q
```

deploy-bot: CI passed — 12/12 checks green. https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/12345/checks

Nina: quick q — the span_count metric is per-request or aggregated? that's needed to know dashboard refresh interval.

Morgan: per-request, we're rolling up into 1s buckets at the ingestion layer. Dashboard panels aggregate with sum over 60s by default.

Mike: left LGTM on the code, minor doc nit. :thumbsup: 

Jordan: approved. :white_check_mark:

Morgan: awesome, thanks all — merging after a quick rebase. I'll post if anything blocks.
